criteria.requirement: Implement feedgen.json_feed.json_feed(feed) and json_feed_str(feed,*,pretty=False), following https://www.jsonfeed.org/version/1.1/ for supported fields: version/title/items, alternate/self/next links, description/language/icons/authors; item unique ID/title, inline text or HTML content, plain summary fallback, URL, aware published/modified dates, authors and enclosure attachments with MIME type/optional nonnegative byte size including zero. Require valid title/content/IDs and reject unsupported external/XHTML bodies rather than silently losing them. Return independent JSON data and UTF8 bytes, do not mutate source or invent extension mappings.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
